$comment: 🔴 THIS IS OUR INVENTED DP MAP. Every entry is status:fiction. It ships in doorlock-1.58 and the current BANOI build constructs frames against it, so it stays the DEFAULT until the app migrates (ozkey-28 §1.1). It is standalone — it does NOT draw from the Tuya catalogue, because it contradicts it. Do not port entries from here into a real profile.
deprecated_note: Collides with the STANDARD Tuya catalogue, therefore with every Tuya lock supplier — not just DS013-T3. ozkey-27 §2.1 and §3.

entries.name: unlock_channel
entries.collides_with: not allocated on DS013-T3; real remote unlock is DP 10 (raw)

entries.name: rfid_card
entries.collides_with: not allocated on DS013-T3; real card unlock record is DP 64

entries.name: fingerprint
entries.collides_with: not allocated on DS013-T3; real fingerprint record is DP 63

entries.name: battery_alarm
entries.collides_with: not allocated on DS013-T3; real battery level is DP 45 (value -1..100)

entries.name: access_result
entries.collides_with: not allocated on DS013-T3. Real unlock reporting is one DP per credential class (61/63/64/69/72/73/76); failures arrive on the DP 60 alarm enum. NOTE: doorlock-1.57's failed-entry BLE pairing gesture hangs off this DP.

entries.name: add_temp_pin
entries.collides_with: 🔴 DP 21 IS navigation_volume (enum mute/low/normal/high). Real add-PIN is DP 16.

entries.name: delete_pin
entries.collides_with: 🔴 DP 22 is NOT ALLOCATED on DS013-T3. Real delete-PIN is DP 17.

entries.name: add_temp_rfid
entries.collides_with: 🔴 DP 23 IS auto_lock (bool). Real add-card is DP 13.

entries.name: delete_rfid
entries.collides_with: 🔴 DP 24 IS auto_lock_delay (value 5-1800s). Real delete-card is DP 14.

entries.name: pairing_request_proposed
entries.collides_with: 🔴 DP 60 IS the alarm enum (18 values incl. pry, low_battery, unlock_attempt). ozdoorlock_core.h:1808 opens the BLE window on this — DELETE that handler before meeting a real MCU. ozkey-22 §7's allocation request is answered: the number is taken.

in_lock.$comment: DPIDs handled IN-LOCK and never forwarded to the MCU. These are OURS and are SAFE — unallocated in the manufacturer space on DS013-T3. They carry over unchanged to real profiles.
